author: Yffe
content: Pin the divergence as failing tests (acto-critic, no production edits): thermite-lower/tests/divergence_golden_intlit.rs asserts emitter==golden on the 1_000_000 literal for both L3 (sum.verus.rs) and L1 (sum.l1.rs); both FAIL (golden has raw 1_000_000, emitter emits 1000000), marked #[ignore] with tracking #54 so CI stays green while the divergence is tracked. Also commit the no-divergence companion tests (divergence_intlit.rs round-trip edge cases; divergence_intlit_lower.rs executable-form value emission). The fix is the generator's call: regenerate goldens to 1000000 OR amend ast.md (R-SPEC-4).
